body.purpose: Effective Tailwind system sans body stack; no custom font.

label.purpose: Status text and small operational labels.

button.purpose: Shared primary and secondary control labels.

metric.purpose: Tabular numerical summaries; responsive size overrides remain in CSS.

motion.name: ease-arrival
motion.purpose: Page, bar and mobile rail transforms.

motion.name: page-arrival
motion.purpose: translateY(7px) to translateY(0); content stays visible.

motion.name: control-feedback
motion.purpose: Button background/press transforms and row backgrounds.

motion.name: navigation-feedback
motion.purpose: Rail color/background, icon-button background and bar background changes.

motion.name: loading-spin
motion.purpose: Loading indicator rotation; accompanying status text remains visible.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Applied to all elements and pseudo-elements when prefers-reduced-motion:reduce matches.

motion.name: review-scroll
motion.purpose: Opening placement review focuses the heading without scrolling, then scrolls it into view; Cancel restores trigger focus.

narrative.overview:
The Imaging Archive is a calm operational workspace: pale working surfaces, teal actions, a fixed navy navigation rail, and a dark canvas reserved for inspecting MRI volumes. Border-defined panels and compact type let study identity, source context and storage state lead.

This records the approved v2 archive and login implementation, extracted from `src/frontend/src/archive/archive.css`, the archive React components, `pages/Login.jsx`, and the effective Tailwind body font. The earlier X-ray routes retain their existing system. Local prototype, synthetic sample and simulation labels are part of the visible interface; this design record makes no model-accuracy or cloud-validation claim.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet light workspace with teal actions and navy navigation.
Mint review surfaces; amber attention states; stable, labeled tier hues.
Compact system typography, tabular figures and inspectable evidence.
Small state-based motion; authored animations and transitions disabled for reduced motion.

rules.name: The Meaning Rule
rules.body: Keep actions, clinical states and storage tiers visually distinct. Pair each state or tier color with a readable label; the teal action color is not a clinical verdict.

rules.name: The Evidence Rule
rules.body: Use compact labels and tabular figures to support study inspection. Preserve source, sample and simulation wording next to the values it qualifies.

rules.name: The Local Scroll Rule
rules.body: Wide study and object tables scroll inside their own focusable, named regions. Keep the phone scroll hint visible and the surrounding workspace within the viewport.

rules.name: The Border Rule
rules.body: Use fine borders and surface tone to group archive content. Do not add card shadows to this flat system.

rules.name: The Visible Motion Rule
rules.body: Content remains visible throughout navigation and placement reveals. Use the existing small transforms, and disable authored animation and transition when reduced motion is requested.

dos: **Do** keep the archive light, actions teal, navigation navy and MRI inspection dark.
**Do** repeat textual state and tier labels beside their colors.
**Do** keep phone MRI inspection to one selected sequence viewport with plane, slice and overlay controls nearby.
**Do** preserve table scroll hints, focusable scroll regions and focused placement review.
**Do** retain synthetic sample, local workspace and simulation labels beside their evidence.
donts: **Don't** use synthetic metadata as MRI imagery or analysis output.
**Don't** present modeled cost, local placement or restore simulations as verified cloud operations.
**Don't** replace compact operational headings with oversized marketing typography inside the archive.
**Don't** add decorative card shadows or animate layout dimensions.
**Don't** hide content during arrival motion or bypass reduced-motion preferences.
